data_fields.name: slot_offset_behind_and_side
data_fields.donor_constant: two tiles behind, two tiles to the side, per 4-way facing (fixed in donor)

data_fields.name: max_step_per_axis
data_fields.donor_constant: clamp to plus or minus 1 tile per axis

data_fields.name: straight_path_limit
data_fields.donor_constant: leader more than 4 tiles away fails the clear check

best_idea: A companion formation as a small binary tree, where each member holds a fixed slot two tiles behind and to one side of its parent, moves one tile per axis per step toward it, and takes the cheapest free neighbour when blocked.
decision_why: Take the slot tree, the one-tile-per-axis step and the cheapest-free-neighbour fallback for companions in zones. Do not take the swap with a party member or the input-driven walk inside a fight. Take the dead-roster idea, but fix the donor's full-party resurrect loss first. Parity row 5 is a weak fit (none of rows 1-23 covers companion formation).
acceptance: A test with a leader and three companions: after four steps north each companion sits in its left or right slot two tiles behind its parent; with a wall on one companion's slot it takes the cheapest free neighbour and never moves more than one tile per axis in a step; resurrecting a member into a full party keeps it on the dead roster or a waiting list instead of dropping it.
